prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Paint EIGHT original sequential poses for a restrained but clearly visible IDLE loop of exactly this fantasy strategy creature or mechanism. The reference strip shows ONE unit in two poses, NOT a group. Preserve its exact identity, silhouette, limb count, equipment ownership, colors, proportions and source-facing camera direction. The primary motion must come from the articulated limbs, wings, tail or mechanism specified below, NOT just bobbing the head. Keep the head and central body almost stationary. A smooth calm in-place cycle, no attack, walking, firing, extra limbs, new props or dramatic deformation.
Wheeled gold-blue crystal ballista with ONE operator seated at rear. Preserve exact camera and gun orientation, not inferred from name. Operator hands adjust controls via elbow motion, mounted lens ring pivots a little then returns. Chassis and wheels fixed. No firing.
Canvas 1536x1024 RGBA TRUE transparent background. Four columns and two rows, exactly eight sequential COMPLETE poses in reading order. Each stays fully inside its 384x512 cell with at least 24px transparent margin on all sides. Same anatomical scale and fixed root/ground baseline in all eight cells. Wide creatures fit naturally at smaller height; NEVER crop tails, wings or weapons or squeeze proportions. Rest, small adjustment, further adjustment, crest, halfway back, easing down, almost rest, rest. Detailed hand-painted original fantasy strategy sprite, crisp readable anatomy, no labels/grid/floor/background/shadow. Genuine new paintings, no rigid translated copies.
